title: Request and activate your York 1Password employee account
issue: You need a York 1Password account for work
resolution_html:
1. Email askIT@yorku.ca from your primary York email address and request 1Password access
  2. After York activates the account, open the invitation sent from 1Password and select Join now
  3. Complete the setup with a unique 1Password account password and retain recovery information securely
  4. Sign in through York’s 1Password sign-in page

For screenshots and account-specific steps, use the maintained York onboarding instructions
